description: This PHP source file defines a Publisher class responsible for synchronizing a hierarchical page structure with Confluence via API calls. It manages page creation, updates, deletion, and diff visualization, and interacts with other components such as Api, Config, RunAction trait, and auxiliary classes like PublisherDelete and PublisherUtilities.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: Main class responsible for publishing and synchronizing pages to Confluence, including diff management, page creation, updates, and deletions, with integrated console output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes publisher with configuration, API client, console output, and width settings.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an action with a given title and closure, maintaining consistent context.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Recursively compares local and remote page trees, displaying differences and changes.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Main entry point for publishing a page tree, managing existing pages, creating missing ones, and applying updates.

methods.name: rootNotFound
methods.description: Handles the error case when the root page is not found, providing guidance.

methods.name: configureSpace
methods.description: Sets up the space context for subsequent API calls based on a given page.

methods.name: getRootPage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the root page for the given tree, configuring space accordingly.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new Confluence page with specified parent, entry data, and existing publication info.

methods.name: createPlaceholderPage
methods.description: Creates an empty placeholder page in Confluence.

methods.name: recursiveWithCallback
methods.description: Recursively navigates the page tree, applying a callback to each node.

methods.name: createRecursive
methods.description: Creates pages and their hierarchy recursively based on the page tree and existing publication data.

methods.name: updateRecursive
methods.description: Updates pages recursively based on changes detected.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates a specific Confluence page if changes exceed the threshold, including attachments.
